input.prompt: The camera is completely locked off like a tripod shot: no zoom, no push-in, no drift, no pan, no camera movement at all. The yellow print on her black T-shirt (the words '1966', 'ISLAY', 'WAS', 'FRUIT' and the seagull line drawing) stays exactly the same: same letters, same spelling, same shapes, never redrawn, never morphing, it only moves naturally with the fabric. A cool young Japanese woman stands still at a dim whisky bar counter, staring straight into the camera with a completely deadpan, expressionless face, slightly surreal. She speaks one short sentence quietly and slowly in Japanese directly to the viewer, her lips moving naturally as if saying 'Single malt wo shiranai to... kono imi wa, wakaranai.', with a tiny pause before the last words. Her eyes never leave the camera, she does not smile, her head and shoulders stay almost still. Only her lips, a slow blink and a few strands of hair move. The warm bokeh lights of the bar softly glimmer in the background. Avoid: zoom, zooming in, zooming out, camera push-in, dolly, pan, tilt, camera shake, garbled text, changing letters, misspelled words, nonsense text, extra text, new text, morphing print, print redrawing, warped logo, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, face morphing, identity change, different person, teeth distortion, flicker, watermark, captions, subtitles
